claims: Apple has released its first Background Security Improvements (BSI) update (iOS 26.3.1 a).
IOS 26.3.1 a patches a critical WebKit vulnerability (CVE-2026-20643).
CVE-2026-20643 could allow malicious websites to bypass security protections.
Background Security Improvements (BSI) allows for rapid, small security patches without a full OS reboot.
BSI specifically targets Safari, WebKit, and system libraries.
The BSI update fixes a WebKit bug.
The WebKit bug could allow cross-origin issues.
Cross-origin issues can expose user data to malicious websites.
BSI is supported on iOS 26.1, iPadOS 26.1, and macOS 26.1 or later.
BSI replaces the previous Rapid Security Response (RSR) system.
The Rapid Security Response (RSR) system was used in 2023.
BSI patches can be removed in the settings if they cause compatibility issues.
